title: Downward-correction drift: long sectors' downward-untouched filers, short broadly downward-corrected filers, per-sector net-zero on the death-inclusive cohort, conditioned on last_avail vintage stamps

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The issuer, its certifying officers and its auditor are the FORCED actor: once a previously certified value is discovered misstated, the restatement regime forces a corrected resubmission of an already-old period. The forced disclosure arrives as an amendment attached to a stale period — no earnings day, no guidance event, no headline. The slow-to-react actor is the marginal holder who attends only to fresh earnings events (limited attention) and reprices the corrected value gradually over subsequent weeks and quarters.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: A downward correction certifies that a previously audited, publicly relied-upon number was overstated: it is adverse selection revealed about disclosure quality, and its content is negative regardless of the period it patches. Because the correction is low-salience (filed vintage structure, not an earnings headline), the information diffuses slowly (gradual-information/limited-attention underreaction), producing post-correction drift. Direction matters asymmetrically: an upward correction retires doubt, a downward correction creates it — so the drift should concentrate on the down side. The effect requires a death-inclusive cohort to measure honestly: chronic downward correctors are disproportionately names that later die, which a survivor-only panel would censor out of the short leg exactly where the penalty realizes.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: rev_dir on the V10-R1 clock: for each entity and decision date, the share of the entity's most-recent as-of-t field-period groups (depth>=2 vintage groups from the staged v10_revision_observables.jsonl layer, sha 7110cbf0...) whose value was corrected DOWNWARD between first and last vintage; available at last_avail only; severity leg from rev_mag on V10-R2 (median relative magnitude among down-revised groups). No price, volume, or ratio-of-levels input anywhere in the exposure.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) corrections are efficiently impounded on this cohort: anchor expectancy <= 0 after band costs; (ii) the up-mirror control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign alpha — then the drift follows REFILING ACTIVITY per se (attention/workflow), not adverse direction content, and the family dies (falsification-by-control cluster, instances #8-#10 precedent); (iii) fewer than 2 of 3 folds positive or drop-one expectancy <= 0; (iv) the pre-selection identifiability or novelty gates declared below fail — the proposal dies at D2 before any scored cell.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation is 'any amendment is bad news, direction is decoration'. The up-mirror control kills it: the identical breadth machinery run on rev_dir = +1 (upward corrections), same long-low/short-high convention. Under the mechanism, upward corrections should carry NO positive drift (their breadth rank should if anything invert the anchor). If the up-mirror earns >= 0.5x the anchor's alpha with the same sign, information is refile activity, not sign content — the family is falsified. It genuinely discriminates because up-incidence (43% of changed groups) is a disjoint population from down-incidence (57%) at group level, so the control is neither rank-identical to the anchor nor vacuous.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector downward-correction breadth predicts next-quarter relative returns: the high-down-breadth tercile (short) underperforms the low-breadth/clean tercile (long) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.1; (c) risk-matched SPY-excess positive in >= 2 folds and overall alpha > 0; (d) mapped sector-ETF factor positive share <= 0.35; (e) the up-mirror control's |alpha| < 0.5x the anchor's alpha — same-sign reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (f) the severity neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (g) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs all nine veto entries, measured before selection. Failure interpretations preregistered: (e) firing means refile-activity underreaction, not direction content — withdraw the asymmetry claim; (a) failing means corrections are already efficiently priced on this death-inclusive cohort; (f) sign-flipping means severity dilutes rather than concentrates the signal — withdraw the correction-severity reading. Availability-lag mutation (P3 invariant): pushing any vintage stamp later shifts observable_available_at by exactly that amount, changes no direction, and moves the entity's exposure by at most one decision-grid step; any larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed.

universe.bookable_pool: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) legs of research/control/stocks_free_v9_run/cohort_v9.json (sha 6a95401f...) carried unchanged; GAP_COVERAGE (513) and NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) excluded-with-reasons and recorded; never bookable in any arm; no survivorship re-substitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series.
universe.eligibility_per_decision: bookable pool AND >= 63 price bars through the decision date (inherited floor) AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; UNTRADABLE excluded, L-I3 fail-closed) AND RAW close >= 1.00 USD AND |Q(e,t)| >= 4 qualifying field-period groups (the P0-frozen min_hist floor of 4, reused as the breadth-denominator floor; not tuned) AND the entity's frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names, else that sector abstains the decision.
universe.sector_conditioning: frozen empirical SIC-to-SPDR majority map shipped in cohort_v9.json (sic_sector_map), carried unchanged per plan; every bookable leg carries its sector tag from the cohort build.

cited_funded_clocks.note: excludes 66,891 ZERO_BASE rows (direction still available for those); ZERO_BASE/flat rows carry null-or-zero magnitude and enter no magnitude leg
cited_funded_clocks.use: neighbour severity median over down-revised non-null magnitudes

clock.conditioning_rule: a decision at session t observes a group only if observable_available_at (= last_avail) < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; staleness bound 0 <= t - observable_available_at <= 800 days; no contemporaneous inputs; conditioning is always on last_avail (revision semantics, P2 clock_semantics); deadline-distance never cited (DATA_BLOCKED_VALID, P2 not_funded); no timing-family clock (V10-T1..T3) enters any arm — no timing feeder is declared.
clock.per_field_basis: per field f, only the group with maximum eff among the entity's groups satisfying the two conditions above enters Q(e,t) — one observation per field, so heavily-amended fields do not multiply-count.

warmup_rationale: revision observables are read directly per depth>=2 group as-of the decision (no own/cohort norm seeding, no YoY delta legs — V8 F2 ratio-level precedent warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start already seeds ADV63 for band assignment; the 63-bar floor is the inherited eligibility floor, not a signal warmup.
decision_grid: inherited 21-session grid: sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0,1,2,...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring; approximately 26-28 scored decisions per fold across S0_FOLD_1/2/3, >= 75 total (exact counts fixed by the session grid before scoring). No finer grid demanded and none declared: correction stamps accrue at filing cadence (last_avail arrives weeks to years after period end), so a 21-session step cannot sample inside a sub-step event, and the availability-lag mutation guarantees stamp shifts propagate by whole evidence stamps, not intra-grid timing.

entry_exit_fills.signal_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under observable_available_at < gate(t); fills at the next allowed session close (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill).
entry_exit_fills.fill_check: verbatim from P3: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.exit_at_last_close: verbatim from P3: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation); the exit cost path is resolve_exit_band_bps — C-rate ceiling when the band has become UNTRADABLE/missing, never the silent fallback (L-I3 kernel, cited below).
entry_exit_fills.holding: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank-hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile (effective holding 1-2 quarters); book forced flat at every fold boundary.
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short: within each sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the bottom tercile and short the top tercile of the exposure (descending = short), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9. Tercile boundaries: midrank ties at a boundary join the lower (long) tercile — deterministic and conservative (the short leg is strictly the highest exposures). The structural clean-mass of the down-breadth distribution (most entities rarely correct downward) is declared ex ante and concentrates in the long tercile; the short-leg population gate in pre_selection_identifiability_check ensures the signal-bearing side is populated.

costs.model: inherited band model, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim — BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of: ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps(name, bands) * cost_mult / 10_000.0.
costs.fail_closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError — the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden (L-I3); an entry never reaches costing with an UNTRADABLE band; exits of held names use resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing — V9-R1 remediation, never cheaper than C).
costs.stress: stress rerun is cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL; reported alongside base.
costs.expected_blend: the dead leg skews to lower dollar volume, so the blended base cost is expected between 15 and 25 bps per side; fills, cost and booked PnL reported split by band for base AND stress.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule; all arms RUN under evidenced semantics (P-3): every input row is a staged depth>=2 vintage group with a recorded last_avail stamp; no asserted timestamps anywhere (P-1); each arm is testable under the P3 availability-lag mutation.
arms.anchor: down-correction breadth: exposure down(e,t) (formula in exposure_definition), per-sector long-low/short-high terciles. Claim: breadth of downward corrections to already-certified values predicts negative drift on the corrected names.
arms.neighbour_mechanism: correction severity: sev(e,t) = median of rev_mag over {(f,eff) in Q(e,t) : rev_dir = -1, rev_mag non-null}, under V10-R2; entities with no down-revised group rank at the extreme clean end by declared construction (declared tie mass, counted in the tie gate). Same long-low/short-high convention. Required SUPPORT with same-sign alpha: if severity carries the opposite sign, the direction story does not concentrate in the size of the correction and the severity reading is withdrawn (declared support-failure interpretation, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.causal_placebo_control: up-mirror (direction-flipped placebo): up(e,t) = |{(f,eff) in Q(e,t) : rev_dir = +1}| / |Q(e,t)|, identical machinery, identical normalization, identical tercile book, same long-low/short-high convention. Under the anchor mechanism, upward corrections retire doubt and should NOT reproduce positive long-low/short-high alpha. Kill rule: if the up-mirror reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x with the same sign (control_alpha_abs_ratio gate), the drift follows refile activity, not adverse direction — the family is falsified per the P3 causal_control_rule (cluster instances #8-#10 precedent).
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs up-mirror: disjoint incidence at group level (a changed group is up OR down); at entity level both are zero for never-changed entities (shared clean mass, declared ex-ante expectation pooled rho 0.1-0.5, gate 0.70 below). The control's discriminating power comes from the 43% of changed groups that are upward: under the direction-asymmetry claim they dilute or invert the anchor; under the activity claim they reproduce it. Correlation declared ex ante, never argued post hoc.

exposure_definition: At each decision date t (session gate g(t) = 00:00 UTC of session t), for entity e: Q(e,t) = { (f, eff) : the group (e, f, eff) exists in the staged v10_revision_observables.jsonl layer (sha 7110cbf010ae6d3f414a1a45eec1e504aff5e94464755991e98605e4795657c2), observable_available_at < g(t), 0 <= t - observable_available_at <= 800 days, and (f, eff) is the maximum-eff group of field f for e among groups satisfying the two prior conditions }. Exposure value: down(e,t) = |{(f,eff) in Q(e,t) : rev_dir = -1}| / |Q(e,t)|, defined iff |Q(e,t)| >= 4; entities with |Q| < 4 are ineligible (not zero-ranked). Normalization: none beyond the share (raw value used for ranking AND for the D2 veto measurement — the within-sector tercile standardization applied for trading is monotone within sector and the veto is measured on the raw pooled rank, the conservative choice). Ranking direction: descending down(e,t) = short side, ascending = long side. Inputs: rev_dir only (V10-R1) plus the two as-of conditions; no price, no level ratio, no delta-of-levels, no magnitude in the anchor. The same formula, evaluated on the same cohort and frozen decision dates, is what D2 ranks against each veto entry (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled).

pre_selection_identifiability_check.purpose: the V8 a5 lesson: control identifiability and anchor non-vacuity must be measurable BEFORE selection, from data alone, no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.rule: On every frozen decision date t over S0_FOLD_1/2/3, over the pre-check universe = bookable-pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns): (R1) RANK GATE - pooled |mean Spearman rho| between the anchor rank vector and the up-mirror control rank vector <= 0.70, and per-date rho <= 0.70 on >= 90% of dates; (R2) CONTROL NON-DEGENERACY - names with up(e,t) > 0 form >= 10% of the measured universe pooled, and both control terciles populate with >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates; (R3) COVERAGE GATE - the anchor rank is populated on >= 60% of the measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4) ANCHOR SHORT-LEG POPULATION - the anchor's top tercile contains >= 6 names with down(e,t) > 0 on >= 90% of dates (the declared clean-mass sits in the long tercile by construction; the gate binds on the signal-bearing side). Declared expected outcome: R1 in the 0.1-0.5 band. Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection (INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE / INELIGIBLE_VACUOUS_CONTROL, fail-closed, V4 + V8 a5 precedent); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.inputs: revision observable layer under the cited clocks + staged price bar availability ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns — nothing scored exists at measurement time.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per P3 factor_and_benchmark), per fold and overall; require excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds and overall alpha > 0; raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor; the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.stage_a_gates_applied_with_no_relaxation: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; folds positive >= 2; populated-fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15; ETF positive share <= 0.35; fold positive share <= 0.5; anchor overall alpha > 0; control |alpha| ratio < 0.5; neighbour same-sign support required; margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2); reproduction ALL_MATCH from a detached tree.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 80); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are legitimate exclusions; the max contributor may be a dying name — that is a legitimate drop, not a special case).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-signal-leg: recompute the anchor breadth over only depth >= 3 groups (corrections that required multiple resubmissions — the most confidently-corrected subset); survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the premium exists only across single-amendment noise, the correction-content reading is withdrawn.

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: declared BEFORE any scored PnL exists, per P-2; anticipations, not thresholds — the binding thresholds are the inherited gate table and nothing here relaxes them.
margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0.0: MOST LIKELY BINDING GATE: 10-25 bps per side on a quarterly book whose short leg concentrates recently-corrected, often low-ADV names; the anticipated margin is small and positive if the channel is real, and the stress rerun (2x) is expected to consume roughly half of it.
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.1: second-most-likely binding; a low-salience drift channel is expected to produce PF in the 1.05-1.25 band if real; thin margin declared ex ante.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_and_fold_positive_sh: S0_FOLD_1 (2018-04..2020-09) is the anticipated weak fold: the Feb-Mar 2020 terminal event realizes the short side violently, then mean-reverts inside the hysteresis holding window; declared risk is fold-1-negative / folds-2-3-positive, which still passes the >= 2 gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: expected to pass with margin for a per-sector net-zero book at gross <= 2.0; tail risk is death clustering on the short leg inside one sector-quarter, only partially capped by the 63-bar/band floors.
margin_to_fail_expectations.etf_positive_share_le_0.35: expected to pass by construction (per-sector net zero); a fail would mean tercile legs leak sector tilt via unequal sector populations, which the per-sector net-zero rule makes structurally unlikely.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: THE SPECIFICITY GATE: expected to pass if and only if sign content (not refile activity) carries the spread; the R1-R4 pre-selection gates exist precisely so this comparison is meaningful if reached.
margin_to_fail_expectations.neighbour_support: expected same-sign; a severity sign disagreement is declared as support-failure interpretation, not a tuning opportunity.
margin_to_fail_expectations.margin_to_fail_reporting: at scoring, every gate reports its distance to the failure threshold; a survivor reporting knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% of MDD headroom) is treated as thin-margin class per P-2 regardless of pass count.

novelty_declaration.novelty_standard: measured decorrelation pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden ancestor rank and shadow, measured at D2 BEFORE selection — never prose; the exposure formula above is written so D2 can compute the rank correlation on the same cohort directly.
novelty_declaration.cross_sectional_momentum_63s_prior_retur: CLEAN BY INPUT DISJOINTNESS - no price series enters any exposure; the only price-derived quantities are the 63-bar floor, ADV63 band eligibility and the >= 1.00 price floor, all sanctioned eligibility/cost inputs, not signals. D2 gate: pooled |rho| <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.semivariance_share: CLEAN - no variance/semivariance quantity anywhere; no OHLC-derived shape. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.plain_vol_level_sorting: CLEAN - no vol-level, no band-of-vol, no range quantity. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.WC_stock_intensity: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION - the exposure is an incidence share over field-period groups, not any AR/INV/AP level or stock; WC fields may appear among the field-agnostic basis but only through their revision direction, a filing-event property. D2 gate <= 0.20 (measured, never argued).
novelty_declaration.Goodwill_Assets_bloat: CLEAN BY FIELD DISJOINTNESS - no Goodwill and no Assets level enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.F1_accrual_flow: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION - no accrual FLOW composite (no delta-of-WC-over-Assets); a downward revision of a WC field is a restatement event on the vintage axis, not an accrual flow. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.depletion_runway_interaction: CLEAN - no (delta-RE, Cash, Assets) construction, no interaction form of any rejected family. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.cash_level_Cash_over_Assets: CLEAN - no cash or asset level enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.sector_exposure_form: CLEAN BY DESIGN - per-sector net-zero book; sector is the neutralizer, not the exposure; the V4 participation lesson (long-beta masquerade) is covered by the ETF-share gate and the SPY/ETF incremental-alpha tests. D2 gate <= 0.20 on the raw exposure rank.
novelty_declaration.v10_lane_separation: NOT the filing-timing lane: no first_lag_days, no own_z, no cohort_z, no deadline-distance (DATA_BLOCKED_VALID anyway) enters any arm — all conditioning is on the revision axis' last_avail stamps via V10-R1/R2. NOT Sloan accruals, NOT Goodwill/bloat (forbidden lineages absent by construction and by measured gate).

literature: Palmrose, Z.-V., Richardson, V.J., Scholz, S. (2004), 'Who Restates Financial Statements and Why? An Empirical Examination of Firms Restating Quarterly Earnings', Review of Accounting Studies 9(1), 55-102 (restatement events carry adverse content; the correction population this exposure measures).

Hribar, P., Jenkins, N.T. (2004), 'The Effect of Accounting Restatements on Earnings Revisions and the Cost of Capital', Review of Accounting Studies 9(2-3), 337-356 (restatements produce persistent repricing through elevated cost of capital — the drift channel).

Hirshleifer, D., Lim, S.S., Teoh, S.H. (2009), 'Driven to Distraction: Extraneous Events and Underreaction to Earnings News', Journal of Finance 64(5), 2289-2325 (limited attention slows impounding of low-salience disclosures — amendments to old periods are maximally low-salience).

Hong, H., Stein, J.C. (1999), 'A Unified Theory of Underreaction, Momentum Trading, and Overreaction in Asset Markets', Journal of Finance 54(6), 2143-2184 (gradual information diffusion of dispersed news; cited for the underreaction mechanics only — no price-momentum variable is used anywhere).

Zhang, X.F. (2006), 'Information Uncertainty and Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 61(1), 105-137 (noisy-information environments slow price discovery; downward corrections are uncertainty-resolving bad news).
